prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Analytics & Customer Success Engineer
I’m looking for a “Web analytics Engineer” experience in Google Analytics, Data Studio and Performance Marketing, to help our customers succeed utilising our product. Desired person should have experience in Performance marketing for B2B SaaS, and able to come up with ways how one’s can improve existing setup and steps to take. We have a templates Data Studio dashboard of how it should look like (But some customers also will also have their own tweaks) This task about providing technical support to our customers as well as giving own suggestions on how to improve things. So we looking for someone that can help us on-demand on an ongoing basis. Requirements: Strong analytical thinking Strong understanding of front-end frameworks and technologies (JS, React, CMS’s) Ability to freely use google analytics (UA and GA4), and know-how to extract actionable insights from data Familiarity with Git, aws, google sheets Google tag manager Performance Marketing FB campaigns Google Ads Linkedin Ads Google Data Studio
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need someone who can support customers on demand with web analytics, performance marketing insight, and dashboard guidance while helping them improve their existing setup.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. I’m interested in helping you support customers around analytics, tracking, and implementation details, especially where front-end knowledge and technical problem solving need to work together.

Your role calls for someone who can work comfortably with Google Analytics, Data Studio, and performance marketing workflows, while also suggesting practical improvements to the current setup. That combination makes sense to me. I can help review how a customer’s tracking or dashboard setup is structured, identify where the implementation may be limiting the insights they get, and suggest clearer next steps based on what’s already in place. I also understand the importance of being able to adapt to custom dashboard tweaks rather than forcing every customer into the same format.

Because this position sits between technical support and strategic guidance, I would approach it by keeping communication clear, focusing on what is actionable, and making sure customers understand both the issue and the fix. I’m comfortable working in environments where front-end frameworks and web technologies matter, and where technical support needs to be paired with thoughtful recommendations.

I’d be glad to assist with ongoing customer requests, help review analytics setups, and contribute ideas for improving reporting and performance tracking. If you’re looking for someone who can bridge product support, technical implementation, and customer success thinking, I’d be happy to talk further.
